requirements.requirement: The system must include unit tests that validate correct years_in_practice calculation when only enumeration_date is provided.
The system must include unit tests that validate correct years_in_practice calculation when only graduation_year is provided.
The system must include unit tests that validate fallback logic prioritization when both enumeration_date and graduation_year are present.
The system must include unit tests that validate behavior when enumeration_date is missing and graduation_year is null.
The system must include unit tests that validate handling of future enumeration_date values by preventing negative years_in_practice.
The system must include unit tests that validate handling of extreme past dates (e.g., >70 years) without overflow or incorrect normalization.
The system must include unit tests that validate normalized_experience_score is computed within defined bounds (e.g., 0 to 1 or equivalent scale).
The system must include integration tests that confirm the experience measure is present in provider detail API responses.
The system must include integration tests that validate response schema includes graduation_year, enumeration_date, derived_years_in_practice, and normalized_experience_score fields.
The system must include integration tests that validate correct serialization of null or missing fields in the API response.
The system must include tests that simulate upstream NPI data absence and verify graceful fallback without runtime errors.
The system must include tests that validate consistent calculation results across multiple runs with identical input data.
